A photo from a walk on 2026-03-21.  
📷 OM-3 & 75 mm ƒ1.8 (shot at ƒ2.2)

photos.alt: A photo of a view over Paris’ skyscrapers of La Défense on the horizon, with many trees and smaller houses between them in the valley before the skyscrapers, which are faint blue and almost fading into the blue hazy sky above them.
